method: HTTP Range reads of the author ZIP central directory and selected entries; ZIP CRC32 and uncompressed size verified; SHA-256 of original mask bytes compared with the two supplied audit JSONs
interpretation: These user mask files match the public author release. Nonempty-mask enforcement and automatic subset exclusion are inappropriate. Keep image labels from ok/ko independent of pixel-mask foreground; evaluate all published masks as provided. This does not assert completeness of human annotation.
